name: Tom cang song Son
summary: River prawns from the streams and rivers of Phong Nha-Ke Bang, firm and sweet, and not raised on industrial feed. They come grilled, salt-fried, steamed, or rim.
origin: The rivers and streams of Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
texture: The flesh is firm and sweet. The prawns are not fed industrial feed.
howToEat: Order them grilled, salt-fried, steamed, or rim.
The Mooc Spring platter carries mountain-stream shrimp, a different catch from these river prawns.
where: The rivers and streams of Phong Nha-Ke Bang.
seoTitle: Tom cang song Son — prawns at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Tôm càng sông Son are firm, sweet river prawns from Phong Nha-Ke Bang, grilled, salt-fried, steamed, or rim.
